summary: Elder Kageneck gamekeeper who bought the Jägerhof in 1751; same clan, exact kinship to John unknown.
bio: Farmer and 'Kageneck'scher Jäger in Stegen'; bought at auction in 1751 the property later called the Jägerhof in Unteribental and married Katharina Schlupf (1728 Kirchzarten – 9 Apr 1809 Unteribental) the same year. Possibly the same farm Martin Begelspacher farmed as 'Jägerhofbauer'.
occupation: Bauer und Kageneck'scher Jäger in Stegen
